_comment: Greenhollow town runtime config. Cells are the 65x65 town grid; an NPC cell is the character's FEET (bottom-centre), matching scripts/render_town_hero_proof.py and scripts/place_town_npcs.py. ids and dialogueKeys are FIXED by the frozen bundle -- kikisChallenge turns in against npc id `kiki` here -- so they are never renamed to match the art.

npcs.name: Elder Rowan
npcs.text: Welcome home, child. Greenhollow is safe, but the world beyond the gate is not. Follow the south road to Millbrook when you are ready, and mind the woods.

npcs.name: Kiki
npcs.text: You want to be an adventurer? Prove it! Take my challenge, answer what I ask out on the road, and come back here to claim your reward.

npcs.name: Healer
npcs.text: Come in whenever you are hurt. I will mend you, and it costs you nothing here in Greenhollow.

npcs.name: Villager
npcs.text: Save your progress at the well before you leave. Everyone forgets once, and only once.

npcs.name: Villager
npcs.text: Monsters roam outside the palisade now. Fight them and you will grow stronger, but run if a fight turns against you.

npcs.name: Fisherman
npcs.text: The stream runs down to Millbrook, and the mill folk trade well. Long walk, though. Pack something to eat.

exit.note: The one gate, at the SOUTH of the palisade -- design/act1-towns/greenhollow/spec.json ring.gate. toX/toY are act1-world-map.js LANDMARKS greenhollow.exit, i.e. the overworld cell the door stands on.

_dialogueNote: name/text are English FALLBACK strings in the voice of the shipped Port Sapphire entries, so the town is playable standalone. The runtime also posts act1-town-interact to the parent, so the frozen bundle's localised dialogue system takes over once the adapter hands off -- which is why dialogueKey must stay exactly as the bundle has it.
_startNote: The south gate mouth, one and a half cells inside it. spec.json's `start` cell, verified inside greenhollow-walkable.json before shipping. No `foreground` key: greenhollow has no foreground layer, and town.html treats that layer as optional.
_noShopNote: No shopCounter/shopId. spec.json authors no counter position and the walkable authority was traced from that same plan, so a counter here would be invented rather than measured. town.html filters the service list on Array.isArray(cell), so omitting it is supported.
